reviews.title: Yes, yes and yes again
reviews.text: Today was my first day using this app. I wish I had downloaded it months ago. I hope they never try to charge for her. This is a great tool to have in-between therapy visits. Aside from the typing, it’s no different than having a virtual session with someone charging $150 for a 50 minute conversation. And no, she doesn’t just tell you what want to hear. Some of the conversation was humbling because you’re finally admitting the obvious to yourself about things going on in your life.
